turns.text: Good afternoon, I am an AI assistant booking on behalf of my client. May I enquire whether a table for two at 17:00 today is available?
Hello. Yes, we have a table for two at 17:00, it's booked.
Thank you. Could you please confirm the name of the restaurant for the booking?

Wonderful, thank you ever so much. Just to confirm the booking: a table for two (2 people) at 17:00 (5 pm) today, Sunday, 22 November 2026, at Dishoom Covent Garden. We look forward to it. Many thanks again!
Thank you ever so much, goodbye.
